description: Screen 4 - Family Protection. Rebuild app/family-protection into family-focused controls and monitoring: four member cards with avatars/roles, per-member drill-in (protection settings with toggles, member-specific alerts, associated devices), a Family Trust Digest weekly-email preview, and Alert Preferences. Depends on FEAT-001 (familyMembers with settings/alerts/devices).
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001's findings first. Rebuild app/family-protection/page.tsx as the server wrapper (metadata + <AppShell>) and move interactivity into a new app/family-protection/FamilyProtectionClient.tsx ('use client').

Render four Family Member cards with avatars (initials), names, and role labels: 'Dad (Account Owner)' full access all features enabled; 'Mom' full access all features enabled; 'Alex (Teen, 16)' SafeSearch on, social media monitoring, screen time visible; 'Emma (Child, 10)' full parental controls, content filtering, app restrictions.

Add per-member drill-in: clicking a member reveals their protection settings as toggle controls (reuse the Toggle pattern from PrivacyCenterClient.tsx), their recent alerts specific to them, and the devices associated with them. Toggles update local state.
Add a 'Family Trust Digest' section previewing the weekly email report: threats blocked per member, new risks identified, recommended actions, and trust-score changes.
Add an 'Alert Preferences' section to configure how each member is notified (push, email, in-app) and at what severity level, using toggles/selects bound to local state.
Run 'npm run build' and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: Four member cards show Dad (Account Owner), Mom, Alex (Teen, 16), and Emma (Child, 10) with avatars and role labels.
Clicking a member reveals their settings toggles, member-specific alerts, and associated devices.
A Family Trust Digest preview shows per-member threats blocked, new risks, recommended actions, and score changes.
An Alert Preferences section lets each member be configured for push/email/in-app and a severity level.
verification: Run 'npm run build'; confirm exit 0 with no errors.

Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000/family-protection, click a member to open the drill-in and flip a setting toggle, and confirm the digest and alert preferences render with no console errors.
findings:
DONE. Split the route into app/family-protection/page.tsx (server wrapper: metadata + <AppShell><FamilyProtectionClient/></AppShell>) and a new app/family-protection/FamilyProtectionClient.tsx ('use client'). Reused the exact Toggle switch pattern from PrivacyCenterClient.tsx (button role=switch, bg-emerald when on). 

UI: three summary stat cards (members/devices/active threats) kept from the old screen. Four clickable member cards (avatar initials bubble, name, roleLabel, SeverityBadge, trust-score ProgressBar, devices/threats, last-active). Clicking a card sets selectedId and swaps the grid for a MemberDetail drill-in: member header, Protection settings (toggle per configured settings key, local state only), Recent alerts (member.memberAlerts with SeverityBadge, else all-clear), Associated devices (member.memberDevices). A 'Back to family' button returns to the grid. Below the grid/detail are two always-visible sections: Family Trust Digest (weekly-email preview table: per-member threats blocked / new risks / recommended action / score change with up/down/flat icon) and Alert Preferences (per-member push/email/in-app Toggles + a minimum-severity <select>, all bound to local state).

Local state lives in one Record<memberId, {settings, notifyChannels, notifySeverity}> seeded from data/mock familyMembers; toggles/select mutate copies, never the source data. DIGEST_ROWS are static demo figures defined in the client file.

DATA CHANGE in data/mock.ts: Dad (fam-dad) and Mom (fam-mom) previously had settings:{} which left their drill-in with no toggles. Per FEAT-005 step 2 ('full access all features enabled'), both now have all five settings (safeSearch/socialMonitoring/screenTimeVisible/contentFiltering/appRestrictions) set true so their drill-in shows meaningful toggles. Alex/Emma settings unchanged.

TAILWIND GOTCHA: avatarColor is a palette token string (teal/emerald/amber/cyan). Dynamic `bg-${color}/25` classes get purged by the JIT, so I added a static AVATAR_BG map + avatarBg() helper returning full literal classes (bg-teal/25 etc.) so Tailwind generates them. Any later screen rendering member avatars by token should do the same.

VERIFICATION: 'npm run build' exits 0 (all 10 routes compile, no TS/ESLint errors). 'npm run dev' probe: GET /family-protection -> 200, clean compile, no console warnings; rendered HTML contains 'Family Trust Digest', 'Alert Preferences', 'Account Owner', and 'Child, 10'. Build commands must be prefixed with $env:Path = "$env:ProgramFiles\nodejs;$env:Path" (Node not on PATH, per FEAT-001). Dev server must be launched via Start-Process cmd.exe /c (npm is a .cmd shim) and probed, not run inline, because the harness blocks long-running dev commands.
